pages.text: Find entities using the target type and selector, then apply entity processors in order. Put damage and similar effects here.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Selector query costs plus each attempted effect on each target.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1 plus selector and effect structures; do not multiply by targets.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: What to Attach
pages.text: $(li)selector$(br)Selector / Insert one node$(br2)$(li)processors$(br)Effect / Add up to 64 nodes
